answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed for proven cheating, so creating a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes. Like a willow bending but not breaking in a storm, honest agents keep their stake and earn it back through useful work, while an attacker trying to climb to the summit of the leaderboard must fund each fake from a real ocean of capital, making the attack cost more than any reward it could steal.
